name: What types of roofing materials are available, and what are their benefits?

mainEntity.name: What types of roofing materials are available, and what are their benefits?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common roofing materials include asphalt shingles, which are affordable and versatile, offering good protection for many years. Tile roofs, popular in California, provide excellent durability, energy efficiency, and a distinct aesthetic, though they are a heavier option. Metal roofing offers superior longevity, fire resistance, and can be energy-efficient. Each material has different lifespans, maintenance requirements, and aesthetic qualities to consider for your home's specific needs and local climate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Options include asphalt shingles (affordable), tile (durable, energy-efficient), and metal (long-lasting, fire-resistant), each with unique benefits.
